text: 7月20日上午，证监会党委书记、主席吴清在北京到证券营业部调研并主持召开投资者座谈会，与包括大中小散各类投资者的8名代表面对面交流，就促进资本市场稳定健康发展听取意见建议。
text_en: On the morning of July 20, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing visited a securities brokerage in Beijing and held a symposium with investors, exchanging views with 8 representatives including retail and institutional investors on stabilizing and promoting the healthy development of capital markets.
